portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL9.4 - libekmfweb: Fix gen of cert or CSR to use RSA not RSA-PSS (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115828)

* RHEL9.4 - chpstat: Fix DPU utilization scaling in reports (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-115843)
